query:
SELECT
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT
                        1
                    FROM
                        email_links l
                    WHERE
                        lower(email_address) = lower($2)
                        AND (l.macro_id = $1
                            OR EXISTS (
                                SELECT
                                    1
                                FROM
                                    macro_user_links u
                                WHERE
                                    u.link_id = l.id
                                    AND u.primary_macro_id = $1))) AS "connected!"
